schema.purpose: FileBlock is the only semantic truth. JSON value structure is the contract; API, SQL, tools are projections. The runtime construction rule is fixed Object values as const objects, stateful semantic Classes as MJS class Instances, and stateless named APIs as static-only classes when a class-shaped API is required. Coding and invocation conventions are detailed by the Handbook coding-style block.

object.name: FileBlock
object.x-boundary: FileBlock is the only semantic truth; SQL/API are projections.

invariants.invariant: Each semantic value has one and only one data owner.
SQL/API are projections; FileBlock is the only truth.
Fixed semantic Objects use const object values; stateful semantic Classes use MJS class Instances created with new; stateless named APIs use static-only classes.
Every MJS project uses Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide through eslint-config-airbnb-extended and ESLint.
Semantic owners collaborate through composition and explicit delegation, not inheritance.
